```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type*} (A B C : Set α) : A ∩ (B ∪ C) = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C) := by
  ext x
  split
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    left
    exact h1
  · intro h
    cases h with h1 h2
    have : x ∈ B ∨ x ∈ C := h1 || h2
    cases this with h3 h4
    exact ⟨h, h3⟩
    exact ⟨h, h4⟩
```
